contrastive.wrong_prompt_definition: grounding uses same-image pointing prompt; pointing uses same-image grounding prompt

decision.winner_rule: only arm B_SPATIAL_KL_CONTRASTIVE may win, and only if it passes G1-G7; arm A is a control and can never win

isolation.test_npz_action: never resolved, hashed, opened or scored

limitations: development validation only: the val split was already used during development; this is not final accuracy
internal train/val sanity only; not CV-Bench task accuracy
no hardware synthesis, latency or speedup claim
no 4B model load, no feature re-extraction, no raw image read
the internal test split was never resolved, hashed, opened or evaluated
the prior spatial-student report's G3-style sign defect is only referenced historically; this experiment computes P5 as selector minus baseline
scope_note: train/val development validation only, CPU-only float32, ~458752-parameter Wt/Wv head (NOT 4B training), no GPU, no 4B model, no feature re-extraction, no raw image read, no CV-Bench, no network, no internal test NPZ open; internal sanity only, not final or CV-Bench accuracy

correct_ndcg_full.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
correct_ndcg_full.definition: arm B minus arm A correct-prompt correct_ndcg_full

correct_spearman.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
correct_spearman.definition: arm B minus arm A correct-prompt correct_spearman

validation_statistics.holm_family_definition: exactly 5 preregistered tests: P1/P2 B-A (correct-same) Spearman and full NDCG gaps; P3/P4 B absolute (correct-same) Spearman and full NDCG gaps; P5 B deployed selector minus L2+anchor retained target mass at K48

P1_B_minus_A_correct_minus_same_spearman.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
P1_B_minus_A_correct_minus_same_spearman.definition: arm B minus arm A of the (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial Spearman gap

P2_B_minus_A_correct_minus_same_ndcg_ful.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
P2_B_minus_A_correct_minus_same_ndcg_ful.definition: arm B minus arm A of the (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial full NDCG gap

P3_B_correct_minus_same_spearman.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
P3_B_correct_minus_same_spearman.definition: arm B absolute (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial Spearman gap

P4_B_correct_minus_same_ndcg_full.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
P4_B_correct_minus_same_ndcg_full.definition: arm B absolute (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial full NDCG gap

P5_B_selector_minus_L2_anchor_mass_k48.aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds then paired effect
P5_B_selector_minus_L2_anchor_mass_k48.definition: arm B deployed selector minus L2+anchor retained spatial-target mass at K48 (selector minus baseline)
